review.description: S3 local qualification requires complete discovered title multisets and exactly one passing execution per scenario, without skipped or retried results. GNU-time RSS remains explicitly an individual-process metric. Hosted comparison and all product behavior retain main behavior.
review.implementation: Read specifications, inventory, validate_run, discover and main. Ordinary subprocess.run executes four worker counts 1/2/2/1 with fixture mode and zero retries; discovery retains both output streams before status validation; failed runs retain report and summary. Main browser topology and hosted workflow are unchanged.
review.tests: Read the three mapped regressions: nested file movement preserves inventory but duplicate titles fail; failed/skipped/timedOut/interrupted/retried/missing/error cases raise; a real failing discovery subprocess retains stdout/stderr and reports both paths. These provide local qualifier coverage; full source qualification is an independent acceptance gate.
